request.purpose: Public health monitoring of chronic disease burden for the regional health authorities.
request.question: What share of patients with type 2 diabetes has any active oral or injectable glucose-lowering drug other than insulin, per region?
definitions: Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Non-insulin diabetes drug = ATC code starting with A10BA, A10BK or A10BJ.
A medication is active on 31 December 2025 if start_date is on or before that day and end_date is empty or on or after that day.
Report per region: patients with type 2 diabetes and % with an active non-insulin diabetes drug, one decimal.
